description: A painted scene of a man in a long dark greatcoat and black bicorn hat, standing in the foreground seen from the side and facing left across a battlefield. To the right, mounted officers in blue and white uniforms with gold braid and plumed bicorns sit on dark horses; to the left, more cavalry and infantry in shakos move through white smoke. Fires glow on a distant plain under a dark, stormy sky. Era cues are early nineteenth-century military dress, bicorn hats, sabres and horses. No text, no frame, nothing gory is visible, and the painting fills the image edge to edge.
